simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲבַעְבֻּעָה (H76) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲבַעְבֻּעָה (ʼăbaʻbuʻâh) means an inflammatory pustule (as eruption) First listed occurrence: Exod 9 9.

definitions.full: H76. ababuah אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת noun feminine plural blisters, boils ( אֲבַעְבּוּעְיָן ᵑ7 ; compare בֶּעְבַּע ᵑ7 , Late Hebrew בּוּעָה בַּעְבּוּעַ , Syriac ) Exod 9:9 אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת מֹּרֵחַ שְׁחִין , compare 9:10 . בוץ so Thes, better ביץ (compare Arabic surpass in whiteness ; whiteness ).
definitions.rootNote: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth);
